BF_KO.why: omitted flag == all 32, and no cell list

REPORTABLE_AS: 54 single-cell effects E(BF_H<h>_L<ll>) = mean over domains of (y_install(cell) - y_install(BF_BASE)), each with a bootstrap ci95; six whole-head HD_<h> arms supplying the bars and ADMISSION, EXCLUDED from every per-cell count; and the BF_KO denominator.
CANNOT_DO: whether any cell is PRIVILEGED among ARBITRARY cells -- there is no control family of arbitrary cells anywhere in this sprint
anything about the SOURCE of the effect -- S-316 blocked that family pending a mass measurement that has not been made
whether the screen predicts for heads that are NULL on button; this family admits only live ones, by design
anything about the other 26 heads, DOMAIN generality, or TEST
anything behavioural: y_install is a semantic readout, not a refusal endpoint
SELECTION_RE_ENTERS_WHEN: any single cell is named as 'the' site. The PRIMARY tests a PREDICTION made before the data existed, which is why it carries a p; naming a winner afterwards is selection on the data that produced it.
DOSE_IDENTITY_IS_BLIND_HERE: 54 cell arms share 224 and seven arms share 2016 (six HD_ plus BF_KO). Identity comes from knockout_cells ONLY (S-292/S-310).
NO_VERDICT: This file contains NO verdict, NO rank and NO p-value by design. Singling out any one head for a claim requires a HELD-OUT AXIS -- see SELECTION_RE_ENTERS_WHEN.

VOID_8_PROVENANCE.WHAT_THIS_IS: each head's whole-head arm E compared to the prereg's frozen prior measurement of the SAME head, codeword and split. A diff above the head's DECLARED void_tolerance is a refusal, not a warning. The tolerance may not be defaulted by this reader. (R29/S-323, R30-A/S-332)

DETECTABILITY_PREREGISTERED.method: S-311: the bar is a RULE, computed from this family's own whole-head arm

BAR_IS_A_RULE.rule: bar(h) = z * SD(per-domain paired delta of HD_<h> minus the base arm, ddof=1) / sqrt(n_domains)
BAR_IS_A_RULE.DDOF_IS_PINNED: S-318 verified ddof=1 reproduces PR-CSI-016's published bars exactly and ddof=0 does not
BAR_IS_A_RULE.WHY_NOT_A_NUMBER: a bar must come from the family it judges. PR-CSI-013's values are frozen as VOID condition 8 instead.

CELL_FAMILY.WEAKER_CRITERION_NOTE: n_cells_with_ci95_excluding_0 is NOT the preregistered criterion. The prereg froze |E| > that head's own preregistered_bar_per_head entry. A cell can exclude 0 at a small fraction of the bar and with the wrong sign; on PR-CSI-014 CL_L11 did exactly that (S-299/S-300). ⚠ AND THE CONVERSE, measured on THIS family (R27/S-308): the bar is 1.96*SE of the NINE-CELL HEAD arm, whose per-domain spread is much larger than a single cell's, so cells exclude 0 far below it -- 7 of PR-CSI-015's 24 non-clearing cells do, the smallest at 14% of the bar. 'Below the bar' therefore means NOT DETECTABLE AT THE PREREGISTERED RESOLUTION, and must NOT be read as 'this cell shows no effect'.
